commit_message:
js, css: Add charset option to js.Build and css.Build
Fixes #15435

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
task_text:
# js.Build / css.Build: expose esbuild's `charset` option (allow `utf8` to avoid `\uXXXX` escaping)

## Proposal

Add a `charset` option to the `js.Build` and `css.Build` options maps to control esbuild's output character encoding.

Supported values:
- `ascii` (default): Escape non-ASCII characters.
- `utf8`: Preserve non-ASCII characters in the output.

This exposes esbuild's existing `Charset` option, which Hugo currently does not provide.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/internal/js/esbuild/options.go b/internal/js/esbuild/options.go
index 9248701f7..8d82e1134 100644
--- a/internal/js/esbuild/options.go
+++ b/internal/js/esbuild/options.go
@@ -160,6 +160,11 @@ type ExternalOptions struct {
 	// See https://esbuild.github.io/api/#platform
 	Platform string
 
+	// One of ascii, utf8.
+	// Default is ascii, which escapes non-ASCII characters.
+	// See https://esbuild.github.io/api/#charset
+	Charset string
+
 	// When you import a package in node, the main field in that package's package.json file
 	// determines which file is imported (along with a lot of other rules).
 	// The default main fields is controlled by ESBuild and depend on the current platform setting.
@@ -385,6 +390,17 @@ OUTER:
 		return
 	}
 
+	var charset api.Charset
+	switch opts.Charset {
+	case "", "ascii":
+		charset = api.CharsetASCII
+	case "utf8":
+		charset = api.CharsetUTF8
+	default:
+		err = fmt.Errorf("unsupported charset: %q", opts.Charset)
+		return
+	}
+
 	var defines map[string]string
 	if opts.Defines != nil {
 		defines = hmaps.ToStringMapString(opts.Defines)
@@ -441,6 +457,7 @@ OUTER:
 		Format:         format,
 		MainFields:     opts.MainFields,
 		Platform:       platform,
+		Charset:        charset,
 		Sourcemap:      sourceMap,
 		SourcesContent: sourcesContent,

+
+// See issue 15435.
+func TestBuildCharset(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+
+	files := `
+-- assets/js/main.js --
+console.log("日本語");
+-- assets/css/main.css --
+p::before { content: "日本語"; }
+-- layouts/home.html --
+{{ resources.Get "js/main.js" | js.Build (dict "targetPath" "js/ascii.js") | resources.Publish }}
+{{ resources.Get "js/main.js" | js.Build (dict "targetPath" "js/utf8.js" "charset" "utf8") | resources.Publish }}
+{{ resources.Get "css/main.css" | css.Build (dict "targetPath" "css/ascii.css") | resources.Publish }}
+{{ resources.Get "css/main.css" | css.Build (dict "targetPath" "css/utf8.css" "charset" "utf8") | resources.Publish }}
+`
+
+	b := hugolib.Test(t, files, hugolib.TestOptOsFs())
+
+	b.AssertFileContent("public/js/ascii.js", "! 日本語")
+	b.AssertFileContent("public/js/utf8.js", `"日本語"`)
+	b.AssertFileContent("public/css/ascii.css", "! 日本語")
+	b.AssertFileContent("public/css/utf8.css", `"日本語"`)
+
+	files = strings.Replace(files, `"charset" "utf8"`, `"charset" "foo"`, 1)
+	_, err := hugolib.TestE(t, files, hugolib.TestOptOsFs())
+	b.Assert(err, qt.ErrorMatches, `.*unsupported charset: "foo".*`)
+}
